name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) – Type A, via Chinese embassies
cov: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend (CNY 2,500 B / 3,000 M / 3,500 P), insurance
lang: English- or Chinese-taught (HSK 4+ for Chinese programmes)
tips: Apply through the Chinese embassy in your country. A pre-admission letter or a supervisor's acceptance email raises your chances a lot. Write a concrete study plan.

name: CSC Silk Road / Belt and Road Program
tips: Explain how your studies connect to cooperation projects between your country and China.

name: Confucius Institute Scholarship (Chinese language & teaching)

name: Schwarzman Scholars (Tsinghua University)

name: Yenching Academy of Peking University

name: Beijing Government Scholarship

name: Shanghai Government Scholarship
cov: Type A full, Type B tuition

name: Jiangsu Jasmine Government Scholarship

name: ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents (Chinese Academy of Sciences)

name: CAS-TWAS President's Fellowship (PhD in China)

name: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship

tips: Apply direct-PhD after your bachelor's.

tips: Public policy and public administration master's. Work experience helps a lot.

tips: Minimum grades: 70% bachelor's, 75% master's, 80% PhD (higher for health sciences). Age limits: 21 / 30 / 35. Choose programmes carefully (up to 12) and prepare for the interview.

name: TÜBİTAK 2215 – Graduate Scholarship for International Students

tips: Islamic studies, Arabic, plus engineering and science faculties. Age limits apply.

provider: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals
tips: KFUPM typically asks for at least 3.0/4 for graduate admission. A good GRE quantitative score is important.

name: King Saud University / King Abdulaziz University – International scholarships
tips: Apply via Study in Saudi and the university portal.

name: Qatar University – Graduate Assistantship
tips: Graduate assistantships usually require at least 3.0/4.

cov: Tuition, stipend, housing allowance (for selected admits)
tips: Strong in energy, AI, Islamic studies, law and public policy.

name: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies – Full scholarship
tips: Mainly Arabic-taught social sciences, humanities and public administration.

name: Khalifa University – Graduate Research/Teaching Scholarship
lang: English (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90 typical); GRE often required
tips: Khalifa asks for at least 3.0/4 for graduate admission. Contact a professor and score well on the GRE.

name: MBZUAI – Fully funded MSc / PhD in AI
provider: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
cov: Tuition, monthly stipend, housing, health, visa
tips: Machine learning, computer vision, NLP and robotics. Show code on GitHub and research projects.

name: NYU Abu Dhabi – Undergraduate (need-based, full aid)
tips: Very selective. Show academic excellence plus a distinctive story. Financial aid meets demonstrated need.

name: UAE University / American University of Sharjah – Graduate assistantships
tips: Ask the department about teaching and research assistant positions.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
provider: US Department of State (via US embassies / Fulbright commissions)
win: Country-specific, often Feb – May, ~15 months before the start
tips: Apply in your home country. For a 2027 start most rounds are closed, so aim for 2028. Show leadership and a plan to bring skills home.

name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship (mid-career)
tips: Needs 5+ years of professional experience in public service.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford University)
cov: Tuition, stipend, travel, up to 3 years
tips: Graduated within the last 7 years. Show independent thinking and purposeful leadership.

name: AAUW International Fellowship (women)
tips: Women who will return home to work. Apply once admitted or while applying.

name: PEO International Peace Scholarship (women)
tips: For women admitted to graduate study in the US or Canada. Combine with other funding.

name: Funded PhD in the US – Teaching/Research Assistantships (any department)
tips: US PhDs in science, engineering, social science and humanities usually come fully funded. Email professors in Sept–Oct with your CV and a short research idea.

tips: Check the current call for eligible countries and fields.
